sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Stick Warrior Hero Battle is a fighting game where players control stickmen characters in various arenas. The gameplay is simple: move your character using the WASD or arrow keys, and attack your enemies using the corresponding keys. However, as you progress through the game, you'll encounter power-ups that can either help or hinder your progress. Some power-ups will give you a temporary boost in speed or health, while others will slow you down or even turn you into a temporary enemy.

The game features different types of arenas, each with its unique obstacles and challenges. Some arenas are filled with obstacles that can harm your character, while others feature moving platforms or treacherous terrain. Players must adapt to these changing environments and use their abilities and power-ups strategically to succeed.

As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new characters and arenas, each with its unique features and challenges. This variety keeps the game fresh and exciting, even after multiple playthroughs.
